milestones.name: Core routing engine
milestones.outcome: A developer can submit a query and receive a response routed to a backend without any configuration.

milestones.name: Backend management and configuration
milestones.outcome: A developer can configure, inspect, and override backends via CLI.

milestones.name: Observability and log inspection
milestones.outcome: A developer can inspect query history and routing decisions from the terminal.

epics.title: Implement query classifier
epics.summary: Analyse query content and assign a complexity tier to inform routing decisions.
epics.objective: Enable the gateway to classify queries into simple, moderate, and complex tiers.

outOfScope: ML-based classification — deferred to future version
Context-aware classification — out of scope for now

acceptanceCriteria: Simple queries (greetings, short answers) are classified as SIMPLE
Moderate queries (code snippets, multi-step tasks) are classified as MODERATE
Complex queries (full application requests) are classified as COMPLEX
Classification completes in under 10ms for 50 sequential queries
epics.name: User Onboarding

epics.title: Implement router core
epics.summary: Select the appropriate backend for a query based on classification, availability, and configured priority.
epics.objective: Route queries to the best available backend with automatic fallback.

inScope: Automatic fallback to next available backend
Classification-aware routing (complex queries skip simple-only backends)

acceptanceCriteria: Query is routed to the highest priority available backend
When preferred backend is down, query is routed to the next available backend
Complex queries are not routed to backends that cannot handle them
epics.name: Core Features

epics.title: Implement OpenAI-compatible API server
epics.summary: Expose an HTTP interface compatible with OpenAI Chat Completions API.
epics.objective: Allow existing developer tools to connect to the gateway without modification.

outOfScope: OpenAI Embeddings endpoint — out of scope
OpenAI Completions endpoint (legacy) — out of scope

acceptanceCriteria: Existing OpenAI-compatible client connects to gateway without reconfiguration
Query submitted via the gateway endpoint is routed and response returned in OpenAI format
Gateway adds minimal latency (< 50ms) to the round-trip
epics.name: Advanced Features

epics.title: Implement backend configuration
epics.summary: Load, validate, and hot-reload backend configuration from a TOML file.
epics.objective: Allow developers to configure backends without code changes.

inScope: Default configuration generation on first run
outOfScope: GUI configuration tool — out of scope

acceptanceCriteria: Default configuration file is generated on first run with sensible defaults
Invalid configuration is rejected with a clear error message
Configuration changes are detected and applied without restarting the gateway
epics.name: Integration

epics.title: Implement backend override flag
epics.summary: Allow developers to force a specific backend for a single query via an override flag.
epics.objective: Enable direct testing of specific backends without changing configuration.

inScope: Override flag in the API request
Validation that override backend ID exists
Bypass classification when override is provided
outOfScope: Override for batch queries — out of scope

acceptanceCriteria: Query with override flag is routed to the specified backend
Invalid override backend ID returns INVALID_OVERRIDE error
Override does not affect global configuration
epics.name: Deployment

epics.title: Implement query log persistence
epics.summary: Persist query history including routing decisions, backend used, and response latency.
epics.objective: Provide a durable record of all queries for inspection and debugging.

inScope: Structured log entry creation per query
outOfScope: Log shipping to external systems — deferred

acceptanceCriteria: Every completed query produces a log entry
Log entries include backend used, latency, and outcome
Log file rotation prevents unbounded disk growth
epics.name: Security

epics.title: Implement log inspection CLI
epics.summary: Browse and filter query history from the terminal.
epics.objective: Allow developers to understand routing decisions and tune configuration.

inScope: Paginated log view with keyboard navigation
Filter by backend and time range
Display backend, latency, status, and query preview
outOfScope: Graphical log viewer — out of scope

acceptanceCriteria: Developer can view recent queries with backend, latency, and status
Log view is fully navigable with keyboard (n, p, q)
Filtering by backend shows only matching entries
epics.name: Performance
